column1: # The gateway's integration cases known to differ when the test run turns the policy controller on
# (SMG_TEST_POLICY_CONTROLLER=on in the environment: every context the test harness builds is then built as
# `--policy-controller` with no controller's address builds it). `scripts/ci_rust_tests.sh policy-controller
# <shard>` holds the run to this list.
# One line a case, tab separated: test binary, case as `cargo test` prints it, kind, why.
#   fails    the case fails with the policy controller on. The run leaves it out, then runs it alone,
#   classic  the case passes, and a classic policy places one of its requests where the policy engine is
# Lines are deleted, not added. The change that cures a case deletes its line: the run is red on a line
# whose case passes now, or whose requests no classic policy places any more. It is red, too, on a case
# that fails or that a classic policy places and that has no line here.
